o.text: Ultimately from Middle Persian 𐭢𐭥𐭦 (gʿz /⁠gōz⁠/). Cognate with Turkmen hōz (“nut; walnut”), Salar xoz (“walnut”), Chagatai قوز (qwz /⁠qoz⁠/).
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *serče. Cognate with Turkish serçe, Chuvash ҫерҫи (śerś̬i).

From Proto-Turkic *yïg- (“to collect”). See more at Turkish yığmak.
The senses ”to dial (a phone number)” and ”to type” might be a semantic loan from Russian набира́ть (nabirátʹ).
From Proto-Turkic *kȫĺek (“young of camel”). Cognate with Turkish köşek.
